title: Ma$k On presents a new single "Up"
htmlContent:
Ma$k On has released a new single called "Up", a that special type of audio that reminds you of why you fell in love with music. He marvels in making beyond great music, but he also shines like a one of a kind star in the visuals to bring you a full picture masterpiece to life, on what is a thrilling experience of music to be apart of.

Ma$k On makes his presence felt in a major way on his new song “Up”. As soon as you hit play his presence is supreme, with his energy speaking to your soul with his rhymes that make you feel every word he speaks. The flow is relentless in it’s approach to push the song forward to it’s rightful destination, over this production packed with a record that doesn’t leave any facet of the craft up for debate.
